title: feat(spec): a record-page tab title a relatedLists entry declares is translatable (objects.OBJECT._relatedLists.LIST.label)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi98qMCtnkL9edrhDJZJffTAD)_
Fixes #36528

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up #36575

## 维护者速读

- 记录页上由父对象自己命名的子表页签标题，现在可以按语言翻译；切到中文等界面时显示译文，以前不论什么语言都显示原文。
- 属于「记录页的页签和字段分组改由父对象一处声明」专题，补上父对象给页签起名后无法翻译的缺口。
- 翻译写错只影响该页签标题的显示文字，数据与页签顺序不受影响；删掉这条翻译即恢复原文。
- 无

## What changes

A record page's tab title that an object-form `relatedLists` entry declares on the parent (`{ list, label, columns }`) wins over the child lookup field's `relatedListTitle`. The field's title had a translation key; the winning title did not. It now has one, on the parent, keyed by the entry's literal `list` (a dotted `object.field` is one key, indexed directly):

```
objects.OBJECT._relatedLists.LIST.label
```

| Package | Change |
|:---|:---|
| `@objectstack/spec` | `ObjectTranslationDataSchema._relatedLists`: a record of closed leaves whose one key is `label` (aliases `name` / `title` / `heading` / `text` onto `label`, like `_tabs`), plus the un-prefixed alias `relatedLists` onto `_relatedLists`. `translateObject` overlays it onto the served object's labelled object-form entries (`translateObjectRelatedLists`), along the locale chain, under the ADR-0029 D9.2a / ADR-0146 D2 catalog rule every other slot follows (a label that diverged from the packaged entry of the same `list` reads only the pair's catalog). |
| `@objectstack/lint` | The extractor walk emits the key for each labelled entry; the orphan rule (`translation-target-unknown`) flags a key naming no labelled entry, with a distinct verdict when the object names the list but gives it no `label`. The shared extension fold now carries an extension's `relatedLists` (the `.custom` arrangement, ADR-0146 D10) and `place` record entries, so a key over a labelled tab an extension brings resolves. |
| `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` | The save door's translated-echo restore puts a translated entry `label` back to its source text (matched by `list`), with the existing `info` advisory, so a Studio save of an object read in another language does not store the translation as the title. |
| `@objectstack/objectql` | `getPackagedObjectBase` (the packaged base the `/meta` read and the form route hand `translateObject`, and the echo restore translates with) carries the tabs a code extender's `place` splices into the owner's `relatedLists`, by the fold's own pass (`applyExtensionPlacements`, so only where the owner declares `relatedLists`), as it already carries the fields such an extender adds. A placed title therefore compares equal to its packaged text and reads the deployment catalog. The `.custom` arrangement stays the customization layer, never part of the base. |

Precedence is unchanged (entry `label`, then the child FK's `relatedListTitle`, then the child's plural label). Only an AUTHORED entry `label` is translated: an entry with no label, a bare name and a built-in tab gain nothing from the key, the rule the field-level `inlineTitle` / `relatedListTitle` docblocks state.

**Where the record page reads the title.** The tab title comes from `deriveRelatedLists` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/deriveRelatedLists.ts`, `title: entry.label`), handed to `buildDefaultPageSchema` as `options.related` (`label: rel.title ?? rel.objectName`). Its `objectDef` is `useMetadata().objects`, the `GET /meta/object` list read, which the REST read exit translates per request (`translateMetadataDocument('object', …)` → `translateObject`), outside the ADR-0156 D3 cached part. So no `ui/` change is made.

**Extension-brought titles.** The registry fold splices a list placement (`place`) and the paired `.custom` arrangement (`relatedLists`) into the parent's served `relatedLists`. A placed title is translated from the deployment catalog because the packaged base now carries the placed entry (round 2, see Acceptance notes); a `.custom` title diverges from the base and reads the pair's own translations (ADR-0146 D2). Pinned through the read's real options (`packagedBase` from `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation#getPackagedObjectBase`, the accessor the REST read's `packagedObjectBaseOf` asks) in `packages/objectql/src/registry-related-lists-label-translation-36528.test.ts`.

Also: `content/docs/protocol/kernel/i18n-standard.mdx` (example and the key-resolution table), the regenerated `content/docs/references/system/translation.mdx`, `authorable-surface/system.json` and the strictness-ledger count, the liveness ledger evidence for `objects`, and `.changeset/36528-related-list-label-translation.md` (minor on spec, lint, metadata-protocol, objectql).

## Tests

| Suite | What it pins |
|:---|:---|
| `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-related-lists-label-36528.test.ts` | schema accepts the key (dotted list included), refuses an unknown leaf key with the strict-object message, names `title` → `label` and `relatedLists` → `_relatedLists`; overlay on a plain and a dotted entry through the type dispatch, the served object still parses; label-less, bare and built-in entries untouched; same array back when nothing matched; locale ladder and fallback chain; catalog loses to a tenant rewrite; pair translation for a changed label |
| `packages/lint/src/i18n-related-lists-label-36528.test.ts` | walk emits only labelled entries; orphan rule resolves labelled keys, flags a ghost / an unlabelled / a bare entry, resolves labelled entries a `.custom` arrangement or a `place` brings (with the unlabelled control); a key over a built-in tab and over a `hidden` `.custom` entry each get their own reason; a dotted list is bracketed in the finding path; verdict and hint each at most 200 characters |
| `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-translated-echo.related-lists-36528.test.ts` | a translated echo restored (dotted list included) with its advisory path; an author's own title kept; a title on an entry the source leaves untitled kept |
| `packages/objectql/src/registry-related-lists-label-translation-36528.test.ts` | through the read's real options (an `ObjectQL` engine's registry, `packagedBase` from `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation#getPackagedObjectBase`): the packaged base carries a code extender's placed tab and its title reads the catalog; a tenant's rename of that title keeps its text; a `.custom` arrangement's title is not in the base and reads the pair's translations |
| `validate-translation-references.test.ts`, `validate-security-posture.test.ts` | the schema-coverage table gains `_relatedLists`; the extension receiver's key-read table gains `place` and `relatedLists` |

## Acceptance notes

- **Merged main once** (`65ce7983`, which carries PR #36517's `.custom` arrangement). The orphan rule's extension fold accepts `_relatedLists` keys for labelled entries a `.custom` arrangement or a `place` list placement brings; its docblock that said `relatedLists` is not translatable through an extension is corrected.
- **The extractor walk does not read `objectExtensions`** (for fields neither): a labelled tab an extension brings is not scaffolded by `os i18n extract` and not counted by coverage. The resolver translates it and the orphan rule accepts its key; scaffolding extension surfaces is a separate, pre-existing gap of the walk.
- **A `place` entry's label applies only where the extended object declares `relatedLists`** (the registry's rule, and the packaged base follows it). The orphan rule accepts its key regardless, the permissive direction: its fold does not read whether the target declares the list (the target may be another package's object the stack does not carry).
- **Sibling gap, not changed here:** the save door's echo restore does not restore `listViews` copy or `validations[].message`, which `translateObject` also translates.
- No in-repo object declares a labelled `relatedLists` entry today, so no shipped bundle and no coverage ratchet moves.

### Round 2 (contract review 7088121343)

- **M1, route (a).** `getPackagedObjectBase` now carries the list entries a code extender's `place` splices into the owner's `relatedLists`, computed by the fold's own pass (`applyExtensionPlacements` over the enabled code extenders, same child-package rule), as it carries their added fields; only the lists are read off. A placed title therefore compares equal to its packaged base on the `/meta` read and the deployment catalog applies; a tenant's rename still diverges and keeps its text. Every reader of the packaged base was measured: the REST `/meta` list and item reads and the form route (through `translateObject`, where `translateObjectRelatedLists`, new in this PR, is the only code that reads the base's `relatedLists`), the save door's echo restore (its `relatedLists` slot is this PR's, and it now restores exactly what the read translates), the share-link label (translates `{ name, label }` only), the validation-message reader (reads `validations` only) and `getPackagedFieldPatchBases` (its bases are read for `fields` only). No reader outside this card's slot changes its verdict; Studio, the `.custom` arrangement fold and the customization-diff and divergence checks do not read this base. Pinned through the protocol accessor the REST read asks, with one ablation (red without the carry). The `@objectstack/objectql` changeset entry is `minor`, as the kind takes, with a sentence true of the head.
- **N1.** A key over a built-in tab (`sys_activity`, `sys_attachment`, `sys_approval_request`) gets its own reason and hint, naming neither `{ list, label }` nor `relatedListTitle`.
- **N2.** A `.custom` entry with `hidden: true` no longer counts as labelled; its key is flagged with its own reason.
- **N3.** A dotted list is bracketed in the finding path (`_relatedLists["event.owner_id"]`).
- **Facade ceiling.** `registry.ts` is a facade at its 6426-line ceiling; its docblock stays net zero there and the why-paragraph lives on the facet's `packagedPlacedRelatedLists`.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:

1. `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`, `translateObjectRelatedLists`: which entries are translated (labelled object-form only) and which catalog a label reads (`valueOverridesPackagedBase` against the packaged entry of the same `list`).
2. `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-translated-echo.ts`, the `relatedLists` block in `restoreTranslatedEchoes`: a save's entry label is put back only when a read of the source translates to exactly it.
3. `packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts`, the `_relatedLists` leg and the extension-fold addition.

Two-minute check, one command:

```
pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/system/i18n-related-lists-label-36528.test.ts
```

Expected: 10 tests pass, among them the zh-CN title served on the parent's `contact` and `event.related_to` entries.
